source.chapter_context: Iron Hands faction keyword on the shared-book profile; Chapter detachment and chapter-book interactions are not included in this shared-book scope.

fixed_data_comparison.scope: Fixed numeric, identity, keyword, default loadout, composition, base, cost and mapped weapon-trait checks. The source option table has no Feirros rows; executable ability interactions and construction admission are covered by the dedicated local suite.

scope: One-model 85-point profile, one-copy cap, 40 mm base, exact source characteristics/keywords and no equipment-option rows.
All four fixed weapons through Equipment and AttackPlan; Bolt Pistol Close-quarters, Gorgon's Wrath Rapid Fire 2/Sustained Hits 2 and Medusan Manipuli Extra Attacks are preserved.
Consolidated local catalog resolution, fixed one-model cost choice and current Marine materialization for both players.
Feel No Pain 5+, Leader, Combat Doctrines, Transhuman Strategist, Master of the Forge, Rites of Tempering and Iron Father are registered.
All four source-listed common-book Leader targets are allowed; an unlisted Vehicle is rejected. The shared relation suite checks all 153 common-book Leader/Support links.

Feel No Pain 5+ applies to Feirros. Rites of Tempering changes wound rolls only when incoming attack Strength is strictly greater than Feirros unit Toughness, and remains active on attached Aggressors.
Iron Father grants Lone Operative while Feirros is within 3 inches of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle; the protection is absent beyond 3 inches and while Feirros belongs to an Attached unit.
Warlord eligibility and public owner-checked declaration; Transhuman Strategist's once-per-round CP.

Master of the Forge's owner-checked Movement trigger; defer at the start of Feirros's move, repair at its end, heal exactly 3 wounds, ignore BS/Hit/Wound modifiers until the next own Movement phase, and expire at that timing boundary.
limits: Closes only Iron Father Feirros's shared-book local datasheet scope.
Does not certify Iron Hands Chapter interactions.
Does not certify full faction/army legality, network behavior, complete matches or human playtesting; network validation remains deferred to final integration.
